# Link

> Words that take you somewhere, underlined with a border so the line colours and animates on its own.

Part of the [Nate Mills Design System](../README.md). It is a CSS class API, not a JavaScript component, so its props are the classes and HTML attributes below. Link the stylesheets as [Getting started](../foundations/getting-started.md) shows, then add the classes. Every component: [Components](../COMPONENTS.md).

## When to use

- A destination inside running text.
- A standalone text link, such as "Verify the credential".
- A text link with a trailing glyph.

## When not to use

- An action on this page: use a Button.
- The main call to action of a section: use a Button.

## Alternatives

- **[Button](button.md):** A link navigates, a button acts. A standalone call to action that must stand out is a Button styled on an `<a>`.

## How to use

**Element:** `<a href>`

- Put `.link-underline` on the `<a href>`.
- Add `.link-underline--prose` inside body copy.
- For a trailing glyph, add `.link-underline--icon` and give the glyph `.icon-size-xs`.

**Classes:** `.link-underline`, `.link-underline--prose`, `.link-underline--icon`, `.icon-size-xs`

## Props

| Prop | Type | Allowed values | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `variant` | modifier class | `prose` (`.link-underline--prose`), `icon` (`.link-underline--icon`) | No class: a standalone underlined link. | Where the link sits. |
| `href` | attribute, URL | Any URL | None. Required. | Where the link goes. |
| `target` | attribute | `_blank` | Absent: opens in the same tab. | Set on every link that leaves the site, with `rel`. |
| `rel` | attribute | `noopener noreferrer` | Absent. | Required with `target="_blank"`. |

## Variants

Available variants: `prose`, `icon`.

- `prose` (`.link-underline--prose`): Inside body copy.
- `icon` (`.link-underline--icon`): Carries a trailing glyph, which takes `.icon-size-xs`.

Default variant: No class: a standalone underlined link.

## States

The CSS styles these states: `:focus-visible`, `:hover`.

## Invalid combinations

Options that must not be used together. Each names the props above.

| Combination | Level | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `.link-underline` with a text-decoration underline | MUST NOT | The border and the decoration render as a double line. |
| `variant: icon` with a glyph that has no `.icon-size-xs` | MUST NOT | The glyph renders unsized. |
| `.icon-size-xs` outside `variant: icon` | SHOULD NOT | It does nothing there. |
| `target="_blank"` with no `rel="noopener noreferrer"` | MUST NOT | The new page could reach back into this tab. |
| Any link with the `external-link` box glyph | MUST NOT | The trailing glyph for a link that leaves the site is `arrow-up-right`. |

## Keyboard

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| Tab | Moves focus to the link and shows the focus ring. |
| Shift + Tab | Moves focus back to the previous control. |
| Enter | Follows the link. |
| Space | Scrolls the page; it does not follow a link. |

These are the native keys of `<a href>`, so they work with no script.

## Rules

| Level | Rule | Checked by |
|---|---|---|
| MUST | Render exactly one underline in every state. | [Automated: Underline gate](../foundations/checks.md#underline-gate) |
| MUST | Give a link that leaves the site `target="_blank"`, `rel="noopener noreferrer"`, a trailing `arrow-up-right` glyph and a `.sr-only` "(opens in a new tab)" cue. | [Automated: External-link lint](../foundations/checks.md#external-link-lint) |
| MUST | Show the focus ring on keyboard focus. | [Automated: Focus-ring gate](../foundations/checks.md#focus-ring-gate) |
| MUST | Give the trailing glyph in `.link-underline--icon` the `.icon-size-xs` class. | [Automated: Component-rules lint](../foundations/checks.md#component-rules-lint) |

Automated checks run on natemills.me before every publish; the scripts live in the private source repository.

## Example

```html
<a class="link-underline link-underline--prose" href="https://natemills.me">natemills.me</a>
```

```html
<a class="link-underline link-underline--icon" href="https://example.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
  Verify the credential<span class="sr-only"> (opens in a new tab)</span>
  <i class="icon-size-xs" data-lucide="arrow-up-right" aria-hidden="true"></i>
</a>
```

## Look

- **Links** are underlined, `{colors.link}` (ink on light, lime on dark). External links open a new
  tab, set `rel`, and carry a trailing up-right arrow glyph plus a screen-reader cue.
- **Standing call-to-action links** use a real 1.5px `border-bottom` in `{colors.border-brand}` rather
  than `text-decoration`, so the rule can be coloured and animated independently of the text. Exactly
  ONE of the two underline mechanisms is ever active on a given link: a border and a text-decoration
  underline together render as a visible double line. A component that draws its own border must also
  cancel `text-decoration` in its `:hover` and `:focus-visible`, not only at rest, or the global link
  hover puts the second line back.
- **A link with a trailing glyph** is `.link-underline--icon`, and the glyph takes `.icon-size-xs`,
  which sizes it to the label and nudges it on hover. Without that class the glyph renders unsized.
- **Action icons** name what the link does: `mail` for a `mailto:` link, `download` for a file
  download, `arrow-up-right` for an external link. Never the `external-link` box glyph, and no icon
  on a same-page anchor, because it never leaves the page.

Values in braces, such as `{colors.border}`, are named on the foundation pages, starting with [Colour](../foundations/color.md); every token with its purpose is on [Tokens](../foundations/tokens.md).

## Recipe

The recipe from [DESIGN.md](../DESIGN.md), one entry per state. Names in braces resolve on the foundation pages.

```yaml
link:
  textColor: "{colors.link}"
  decoration: "underline"
  hover: "{colors.link-hover}"
  external: "opens a new tab, rel set, trailing up-right arrow glyph plus a screen-reader cue"
```

## Classes

| Class | Kind | What it does | Tokens it reads |
|---|---|---|---|
| `.link-underline` | base | base | `--color-accent`, `--color-border-brand`, `--color-text-primary`, `--duration-fast`, `--ease-default`, `--font-body`, `--tracking-normal`, `--weight-semibold` |
| `.link-underline--prose` | modifier | inside body copy | `--color-text-primary` |
| `.link-underline--icon` | modifier | carries a trailing glyph; give the glyph .icon-size-xs | `--space-200` |
| `.icon-size-xs` | base | the trailing glyph inside .link-underline--icon: sizes it and nudges it on hover; does nothing elsewhere | None |

## Tokens

Every token the classes above read, as data from tokens.json: write `var(--name)`, never the raw value. A component token belongs to one component: change it to restyle that component and nothing else. A semantic token is a shared role; never change one for a single component. The three tiers: [Tokens](../foundations/tokens.md#three-tiers).

| Token | Tier | Value | What it is for |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--color-accent` | Semantic | `#1c1c1f`; dark `#d2ff37`, from `--neutral-850` | The single theme-aware interactive role: ink on light, brand lime on dark. Active and selected states. |
| `--color-border-brand` | Semantic | `#d2ff37`, from `--brand-primary` | The brand-lime outline accent (active selection, link underline, brand ring). Theme-invariant lime, never overridden per theme; the semantic the brand outlines read instead of the raw primitive. |
| `--color-text-primary` | Semantic | `#0a0a0b`; dark `#f4f4f5`, from `--neutral-950` | Default reading text. Near-black on light, near-white on dark. |
| `--duration-fast` | Semantic | `150ms` | Hover, focus, and micro state feedback. |
| `--ease-default` | Semantic | `cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)` | The workhorse symmetric curve. Begins and ends on screen. |
| `--font-body` | Semantic | `"Work Sans", "Work Sans Fallback", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif` | Body copy, lists, and buttons. |
| `--space-200` | Semantic | `8px` | Tight gap. Chip padding, small stacks. |
| `--tracking-normal` | Semantic | `0` | 0. The body default; most text sits here. |
| `--weight-semibold` | Semantic | `600` | 600. The workhorse emphasis: buttons, subheads, labels. |
